parameters.epsilon: any ε>0; O(1/ε) round corollary for fixed ε

results.sourceLocation: Corollary 1.5; Section 4 LOCAL proof, printed pp. 25–26; Claim 4.1, pp. 23–24
results.notes: Each Pivot phase uses two communication rounds, followed by one round for cluster assignment. Independently sampled finite ranks create a vanishing correction. The plotted factor a=3+8/(2r−1) is only the leading guarantee; the actual expected factor is a+δₙ. The theorem holds for all integer r≥1; displayed samples stop at r=128. Corollary 1.5 states any ε>0; for fixed ε choose r=O(1/ε) with 8/(2r−1)+δₙ<ε.
results.quality: Expected cost at most (3+8/(2r−1)+n^{−Ω(1)}) times OPT
results.output: Partition into any number of clusters; each vertex learns its cluster ID
results.graph: Unweighted complete signed graph encoded by its positive-edge graph G; nonedges are negative pairs
results.resourceModel: Elapsed synchronous LOCAL rounds on the positive-edge network G; O(log n)-bit messages suffice
results.probability: Expected approximation over independent random vertex ranks; no high-probability approximation ratio is claimed
